source_provenance: Original research Git commit unavailable. The following content hashes identify inspected source files. Record verified Git provenance with the owner before formal submission.
target_definition: Probability of a positive native 15-minute BTCUSDT endpoint return from t to t+15. The reported execution-target comparison evaluates the sign from t+1 to t+16.
preprocessing: Per-component input order, quantile clipping, fallback, probability transform and fitted estimators are embedded. Upstream feature-leaf rules are in pattern_rules.csv.
limitations: Quarterly walk-forward evaluation reuses a historical calendar examined in model selection. Evaluation ends 2025-01-23 23:30 UTC. Current market performance is unverified.
Primary comparison covers successive historical fitted checkpoints. The included frozen January 2025 checkpoint is scored separately below.
Integration requires the upstream causal feature pipeline and data availability checks. No execution, live feed or quarterly retraining is included.
Native training sign and one-minute-delayed execution sign can differ.
